summary: Lot 3 (Monétisation & partenaires) end-to-end tested on https://job-platform-next.preview.emergentagent.com. 16/16 backend tests pass (admin settings GET/PUT + persistence, xml-feeds CRUD with login-less partner creation & existing-partner assignment + import trigger, admin alerts list/filter/toggle/delete, partner campaigns per_click + per_posting CRUD with settings-driven validity). Full Playwright coverage of admin Paramètres / Flux XML / Alertes tabs and partner campaigns (create per_click, create per_posting hides cpc/budget & shows 'Validité 30 j', toggle Active↔En pause, delete, empty-name validation toast, regression on recharge + XML import). All UI + integration flows PASS.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/admin.py: create_xml_feed with a new (login-less) partner inserts a User with hashed_password=None. Confirmed: /api/auth/login for such an email returns 401 (safe, per credentials.md note). Consider adding an index on users.email and setting is_active default explicitly on the User model to avoid future silent bugs.

backend/routes/payments.py::create_campaign silently drops cpc/cpc_max/budget_limit when billing_mode='per_posting' (sets them to None). Frontend already hides those fields, so behavior is consistent, but consider explicitly rejecting the request (422) if the client sends them for per_posting to make the contract clearer.
PartnerCampaigns.jsx uses window.confirm() for delete — inconsistent with the rest of the shadcn-based UI (which uses AlertDialog). Not blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent:
All Lot 3 flows PASS end-to-end. Backend endpoints verified: GET/PUT /api/admin/settings (persistence confirmed across reload); GET/POST/DELETE /api/admin/xml-feeds (both new-login-less and existing-partner assignment work; login-less partner is inserted with hashed_password=None + no_login=True in profile); POST /api/admin/xml-feeds/{id}/import responds (example.com returns 502 upstream which is expected and surfaced as 'Erreur' destructive toast in the UI); GET /api/admin/alerts with search + active=true/false filters; PUT /api/admin/alerts/{id}/toggle and DELETE /api/admin/alerts/{id}; POST /api/partner/campaigns applies settings.pack_validity_days=30 to per_posting campaigns (verified by round-trip and by row text 'Validité 30 j'); PUT status='paused'|'active' works; DELETE works. Frontend: tab-settings shows values 30/10 by default; changing + saving + reloading confirms persistence; tab-feeds new-feed-btn opens feed-dialog and both feed-assign='new' (feed-new-company) and 'existing' (feed-partner-select) code paths save; feed-import-* triggered surfaces error toast for unreachable example.com URL as expected; tab-alerts filter/toggle/delete OK; partner dashboard shows Mes campagnes d'affichage with new-campaign-btn; empty name → 'Nom requis' toast; per_click billing shows cpc/cpc-max/budget inputs, per_posting hides them and shows the admin-defined-validity note; toggle flips Active↔En pause badge; delete removes row; regression: partner-recharge-btn, partner-import-btn, partner-feed-url still functional.
